**API 209 students only.** Not in API 209? Please book [open office hours](/office-hours/open/index.qmd) instead, or email me at rrodriguezramirez \[at\] g \[dot\] harvard \[dot\] edu.

::: {.oh-intro}
Choose online (Wednesdays) or in person (Thursdays), then pick a **15-minute slot**. The times you see come straight from my calendar, so anything open is genuinely open. After you book, you will receive a calendar invite with the Zoom link or the room. Accept it and it lands on your calendar.
:::
